title: Marcus Vinicius's chain smoking after the event
summary: Italo Venturelli tells of Marcus Vinicius's chain smoking after the event, about 1996-2018 at Varginha, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh, a lot. He even began smoking more. He'd smoke all day.

plain: Italo Venturelli, a witness from Varginha, Brazil, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a man named Marcus Vinicius. He says that after the event of 1996 that people there describe, Marcus Vinicius was deeply affected and began smoking far more, all day long. He tells it to show how much the event shook those involved.
